senses.en_definition: An English preposition expressing possession, association, or a position within a whole.
An English preposition linking a quantity, container, or part to its contents or the whole.

messages.en: Do you want to play Age of Empires tonight?
Yeah, but after nine. I've got to finish my work first.
Okay, message me when you're done. I'll be waiting.

senses.en_definition: An exclamation expressing surprise, realization, acknowledgment, or disappointment.

messages.en: I'm still at that junction I mentioned. There's been an accident, and the traffic isn't moving at all.
Oh, no wonder you're late. No worries, I'll wait at the shop. Drive safe.

senses.en_definition: Used to express agreement, accept a suggestion, or confirm an arrangement.
In a satisfactory or acceptable condition; all right.
(Kelantan dialect) Used to tell someone to be patient or wait a moment.

messages.en: Shall we meet at our usual café at eight tonight?
Okay, I'll be there at eight. If you're running late, just let me know.
Okay, I'll message you when I head out.

senses.en_definition: Used to express agreement or acknowledgment, or to move on to the next step.
Satisfactory or acceptable, though not especially good; in a sound or safe condition.

messages.en: Can we meet at the usual place at eight? I'm finishing work a bit later today.
All right, eight it is. If I get there first, I'll grab a table.
